newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: RESEARCH ALERT - DMCI rated buy on Semirara.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - DMCI rated buy on Semirara.

text.p: Construction concern DMCI Holdings Inc was rated a buy on Monday by Angping & Associates Securities Inc due to its planned acquisition of a 40 to 75 percent share in Semirara Coal Corp.
DMCI announced the deal on January 21 which would involve a total consideration of 905 million pesos.

In an advisory to clients, analyst Warren Chua said DMCI's earnings potential would be enhanced with Semirara which will be used by the company as an economical entry point to go into cement production.
"This is part of its move towards backward integration and fortifying its top place in the construction industry," he said.
Semirara's coal site in central Philippines has abundant limestone, which is a key ingredient to cement production, he said.
DMCI plans to take in a foreign strategic partner for its planned $100-million cement plant, he said.
Though Semirara had been posting losses in recent years, it could see a possible turnaround with the entry of DMCI, Chua said.
